artifacts.summary: Nine-phase plan splitting 25 tooling modules into lean_lib BimodalTools, sequenced so every gate's scan root is widened and the B3 separation invariant lands before anything moves.

summary: Plan complete: 9 phases, 11.5 hours, 8 dependency waves. The central structural commitment is that Phases 2-4 widen every hardcoded gate scan root and Phase 3 adds the new B3 separation invariant BEFORE anything moves, so each widening is a verifiable no-op on the unmoved tree and the invariant guards the move rather than describing its outcome; C25N and B3 each carry a negative test. Phase 6 is the only atomic-batch phase (the tree does not build between the move-modules.py run, the 8 Automation.lean import deletions, the aggregator re-points, the 12 exe re-roots and the namespace hand-edits) and is preceded by a dry-run review phase and a clean-tree precondition on FormalSystem/Automation/. Phases 7-9 close the 11 bare-form citations move-modules.py will not rewrite, split NormalizationTest rather than moving it, and assert all four acceptance criteria -- including the .olean check against .lake/build/lib/lean/BimodalTools/ rather than the source tree, which would be empty for the wrong reason. Plan passes validate-artifact.sh --strict with 0 warnings.
